_comment: Story 1-3. The five bookable Cliniko types. Source: Vigil VG-1, read from the
LIVE Cliniko account 2026-07-29, not from Keegan's recollection. The three
⚠️ SCOPING IS CORRECTNESS, NOT POLISH. The account is the SHARED Restore Health
Clinic account: unscoped it offers 13 appointment types across 4 practitioners,
so an unscoped booking embed on Keegan's own site lets a visitor book Adrian
Tomiak, Jake Williams or a naturopath. business_id + practitioner_id below are a
HARD FLOOR that story 1-4's component must not let a caller omit.
⚠️ IDs BREAK SILENTLY. If a type is deleted and recreated in Cliniko it gets a
new id, and a stale deep link does not error — it falls back to a WIDER list.
That is why every id lives in this one file and why launch day needs a
price: null means Cliniko has NO billable item set, not that it is free.
Story 1-5 must OMIT the schema.org offers node for those rather than invent a
clinikoName is reproduced EXACTLY as Cliniko stores it, including the
'(Keegan B)' suffix, because the booking widget renders that name verbatim. The
suffix disambiguates practitioners inside a four-practitioner diary; tidying it
is a Cliniko-side decision for Keegan, NOT something a website story may solve.

services.note: ~~OPS PRECONDITION: had NO bookable sessions scheduled as of 2026-07-29~~ — CORRECTED 2026-07-31 (Quinn, QN-1), and the correction is measured, not assumed: walking the real Cliniko datepicker month by month found 3 bookable days in August and 2 in September for this class (handstand 3 and 1). Keegan scheduled sessions after the original note was written. The probe carried a control — new-patient showed 29 and 11 — because an earlier run reported a FALSE zero by counting before the datepicker had rendered. THE DURABLE WARNING STANDS, and it is why the pages are built the way they are: class availability is Keegan-managed and CAN return to zero at any time, so no page advertises a class time without also sending the reader to the booking page to confirm the session. The bookable state is the source of truth, never the page. SEPARATE and not a defect: every booking entry point shows an empty calendar on the last day of a month once the working day is over. That is Cliniko's own behaviour and it recurs every month end.
